name: The Final Flame
storyline: Altemis, The Goddess of the Hunt pays a visit to a retired mercenary named Zaf to give him an invitation to her tower. Seeking the thrill, Altemis challenges the world and threatens to destroy it once her attack fully eclipses the sun. Zaf, along with other friends and colleagues from different worlds venture to Altemis' ever-changing tower to try and stop her.
summary:
A 2D Hack-and-Slash Action RPG with rogue-lite elements. Play as Zaf along with a variety of other characters to stop Altemis, a bored goddess from destroying the world.

Inside Altemis' tower are ever changing rooms, all with different enemies and use it to their advantage. Choose between 11 different characters with different abilities along with 2 characters to assist you in your fight to the top. Use your strengths, skills, and wits, equipped with Falucites to enhance your abilities and cast strong magic, to climb up Altemis' ever changing tower.
